page.overview:
Who is Nancy B. Ohlson?

Nancy B. Ohlson, RN, was a Starfleet nurse who served during the Dominion War.

In 2374, her name appeared twice on a casualty list, where she was reported by the as MIA, but was also reported by the as KIA. ()
